def kernel(A: Float[Array, '14 12']):
    bprobe_trace = []
    bprobe_v0 = np.zeros_like(A)
    bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v0))
    Q = bprobe_v0
    bprobe_v1 = np.zeros((A.shape[1], A.shape[1]), dtype=A.dtype)
    bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v1))
    R = bprobe_v1
    for k in range(A.shape[1]):
        bprobe_v2 = A[:, k]
        bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v2))
        bprobe_v3 = A[:, k]
        bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v3))
        nrm = np.dot(bprobe_v2, bprobe_v3)
        R[k, k] = np.sqrt(nrm)
        bprobe_v4 = A[:, k]
        bprobe_trace.append((4, bprobe_v4))
        bprobe_v5 = bprobe_v4 / R[k, k]
        bprobe_trace.append((5, bprobe_v5))
        Q[:, k] = bprobe_v5
        for j in range(k + 1, A.shape[1]):
            bprobe_v6 = Q[:, k]
            bprobe_trace.append((6, bprobe_v6))
            bprobe_v7 = A[:, j]
            bprobe_trace.append((7, bprobe_v7))
            R[k, j] = np.dot(bprobe_v6, bprobe_v7)
            bprobe_v8 = Q[:, k]
            bprobe_trace.append((8, bprobe_v8))
            bprobe_v9 = bprobe_v8 * R[k, j]
            bprobe_trace.append((9, bprobe_v9))
            A[:, j] -= bprobe_v9
    return bprobe_trace
